findings.summary: Briefing/Resume find tasks only via hm/ branches; flag-OFF harnesses show none
findings.suggestion: State that Briefing/Resume cover the per-task (worktree-enabled) model, or also list execute- worktrees.

reasoning.observe: Briefing greps ^branch refs/heads/hm/; hm/<slug> exists only with worktree flag ON.
reasoning.trace: Resume step 2 says None -> offer Start.
reasoning.infer: With worktree off, in-progress work is invisible; continue offers Start.
reasoning.conclude: S7(a)/(c) hold only for flag-ON harnesses and the skill does not say so.

findings.summary: Span grep uses a cwd-relative path, but spans live at the base root

reasoning.observe: Template greps .claude/observability/stage-spans.jsonl; stage_spans writes to resolve_base_root(cwd).
reasoning.trace: Router invoked inside a task worktree resolves to the worktree's own .claude/observability.
reasoning.infer: Every task reports stage unknown; Resume cannot pick the stage.
reasoning.conclude: Base-root span ledger not read from a worktree.

findings.summary: Interactive rejection messages are hardcoded English, not locale messages
findings.suggestion: Pass locale into _ask_world_model and print i18n.t(f'world_model_handle_{rule}', locale, handle=raw).

reasoning.observe: interview prints raw name_error and '{raw!r} breaks the {rule} rule'; S5 requires a locale message naming the rule.
reasoning.trace: _ask_world_model is called after _ask_locale but not passed the locale.
reasoning.infer: ko operator typing intent-layer gets English.
reasoning.conclude: S5 locale-message requirement unmet on the interactive path.

findings.summary: Empty-dir cleanup applies to every orphan under skills/, but docs say world-model only
findings.suggestion: Reword the docstring to state it applies to any swept skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

reasoning.observe: Docstring says a renamed world-model router; call runs after every orphan deletion guarded only by parent.parent.name == skills.
reasoning.trace: Any orphaned skill now has its emptied dir removed.
reasoning.infer: Behaviour changes for unrelated skills; docstring undersells.

findings.summary: tojson escapes non-BMP characters (emoji in name) as surrogate pairs inside YAML frontmatter
findings.suggestion: Add a render test with a name like 'Maker 🚀' that parses frontmatter with PyYAML and compares.

reasoning.observe: Description uses | tojson (ensure_ascii); name_error allows astral emoji.
reasoning.trace: Emoji renders as \ud83d\ude80 in a YAML double-quoted scalar.

findings.summary: Resume treats a trailing 'start' span as interrupted, but another live session may own it
findings.suggestion: Before re-entering a task whose newest span is 'start', check for a live session on that slug (marker or span age). If one exists, report 'running in another session' and do not resume. Also skip a torn last line from tail.

reasoning.observe: Briefing/Resume read grep ... stage-spans.jsonl | tail -n 1; 'start' with no 'end' is labelled interrupted and Resume re-enters that stage.
reasoning.trace: Session A starts /hm:execute on slug X (start span). Session B says continue; reads newest span 'start'; re-enters execute on X.
reasoning.infer: Two sessions can run the same stage on the same task; a torn last line could also be misread.
reasoning.conclude: The rule cannot tell a crashed stage from one running in a concurrent session, so Resume can launch a duplicate stage.

findings.summary: ADR-011 behaviours (capped briefing, newest-span-per-slug, 8-line reply, no whole-file reads, interrupted/ended resume rule) are not pinned by any test
findings.suggestion: Add a render test asserting the 7-key filter, tail -n 1, 'at most 8 lines', the Never Read clause, the interrupted/ended Resume rules, and no unfiltered 'hm intent status --json' line.

reasoning.observe: Only 'hm intent status --json' substring is asserted, which also holds for the unfiltered command.
reasoning.infer: Removing the filter or inverting resume passes all tests.

findings.summary: Routing rows (what next starts no stage; record first) pinned only by subset checks
every-dispatch check selects blocks by --locale, a proxy
findings.suggestion: Select by 'make "$(pwd)"' and assert a minimum count.
